name: rock-tumbler
haiku: ten agents said done / the histogram disagreed / open the file
description: A method twin, not a person twin. Rock Tumbler is the harsh-critic loop from a session where ten ambitious single-file browser apps were built by fanning out sub-agents and then verified independently in a real headless Chromium. Nine of the ten reported success while still broken. It ships soul.md (the 7-step loop plus the diagnostic patterns) and a runnable BrowserCritic agent that serves over HTTP, launches Chromium with GPU flags, captures every pageerror, drives the UI, screenshots it, and hands back a number instead of an adjective.
_note: Method twin, not a person twin. Minted from a session that shipped 10 single-file apps benchmarked against named commercial products; 9 of 10 builder self-reports were wrong. Ships BrowserCritic + AdversarialCritic alongside the standard memory cartridges.
